InvoiceFileName.description: The invoice PDF's name in storage bucket InvoicesStorage (folder Tools), e.g. INV-22150825.pdf — the generator's out_InvoiceFileName. The app shows the PDF on the left.

InvoiceJSON.description: The invoice as JSON text, exactly as Extract Invoice Data (IXP) returned it in out_InvoiceJSON: {invoiceNumber, poNumber, invoiceDate, dueDate, currency, vendor {name, address, country, taxId}, buyer {name, address, country, taxId}, lines [{n, description, quantity, unitPrice, lineTotal}], subtotal, taxName, taxRate, taxTotal, total}. The app renders it beside the PDF and anchors the highlighted findings on it.

POID.description: The purchase order number the invoice refers to (PO-<8 digits>; the extraction's out_PONumber, used as the PurchaseOrders POID). The app loads that row (PODATA, POHTML) from Data Fabric and shows it on the right. Action Center stores this key as Poid in the task data; the app reads either spelling.

MatchResultJSON.description: The match result as JSON text. Shape: {status: 'green'|'yellow'|'red', findings: [{area, field, invoiceLine, poLine, severity, invoiceValue, poValue, note}], summary, rejectionEmailHtml}. area: vendor|buyer|tax|currency|line|total|po. field: the differing field (name, taxId, taxRate, description, quantity, unitPrice, lineTotal, subtotal, total, ...; empty for a whole missing or extra line). invoiceLine / poLine: the invoice line n / the matching purchase order line n, as integers; 0, null or omitted when not about a line. severity: each finding carries its own rating, 'yellow' or 'red', not the overall status. yellow = the same goods presented differently (a reworded line, a line split in several, packaging on its own line, a partial delivery whose lines all match); red = a real problem (another vendor, another tax, an item not ordered, a different item, more than ordered, an unknown purchase order). Cosmetic differences ('Ltd.' vs 'Limited', address order, number formats, extraction misreads) are green, not yellow: a green result's findings may carry an empty severity or be left out. The overall status is red if any finding is red, yellow if any is yellow and none red, else green. An empty severity renders as a blue 'Review' marker. invoiceValue / poValue: the values as each document shows them. note: one sentence for the reviewer. summary: two or three sentences for the reviewer. rejectionEmailHtml: the drafted supplier e-mail as HTML, empty for green. Every finding is highlighted on both sides in its severity colour.

RejectionEmailHtml.description: The supplier e-mail drafted by the agent (HTML). Pre-filled from the match result when the process passes nothing; the reviewer edits it in the app and the edited text comes back. The process sends it only on Reject.

ReviewerEmail.description: The e-mail address of the reviewer who completed the task, filled in by the app from the Action Center context. The process writes it into PaymentsQueue.ApprovedBy on the human path.
